_comment: Provenance + integrity manifest for serialized model artifacts. Consumed by src/model_loader.py, which refuses to deserialize any artifact whose SHA-256 does not match here or whose 'trusted' flag is false. See the security audit notes (C1).

_verification.cross_version_result: INVALID — reproduced held-out accuracy 0.506 / recall 0.064 vs intern-reported 0.889 / 0.836; the TF-IDF pipeline unpickled from sklearn 1.7.1 into 1.9.0 does not reproduce the trained transformation. Predictions are unusable.
_verification.conclusion: Artifact is NOT reproducible across scikit-learn versions and must be regenerated from training data (currently missing). C1 remains unresolved.

classifier.pkl.notes: LogisticRegression. Loads on sklearn 1.9.0 with a version warning but yields invalid predictions (see _verification).

vectorizer.pkl.notes: TfidfVectorizer. Cross-version unpickling changes the TF-IDF transform; not equivalent to the trained model.

rana_vectorizer.joblib.notes: Reproducible RANA model; rebuild via fetch_data.py + train_rana.py.

rana_classifier.joblib.notes: Reproducible RANA model; rebuild via fetch_data.py + train_rana.py.
